findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so recorded calls are lost
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`, a new instance, so the `InfoLogs` call count, message and context are recorded on a throwaway object. Any test that injects a TestLogger into NewLoggerMiddleware and asserts on `InfoLogs` will see zero calls. The fake should return `f` so the middleware's output stays observable.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no tests
findings.body: The contextual-logger behaviour (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname attributes) moved into a new middleware with no unit test. Nothing verifies that the context is enriched per endpoint, or that the stream methods are passed through unchanged. Previously this was covered only indirectly through the instrumentation middleware.

findings.title: Logger middleware drops its explicit traceID/plugin fields and relies on the context logger
findings.body: The log line used to add pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName/dsUID and traceID explicitly. It now gets them only from `FromContext(ctx)`. The wrapper's `FromContext` silently falls back to `d.New()`, which carries no request context, when the type assertion to `*ConcreteLogger` fails. In that case, or if ContextualLoggerMiddleware is not earlier in the chain, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log loses all identifying fields without any error. The traceID is no longer added explicitly, so its presence now depends on the infra logger's context providers.

findings.title: Incomplete rename: test and logger names still say 'instrumentation'
findings.body: `TestInstrumentationMiddleware` was not renamed to match the file and type. The logger is still named `plugin.instrumentation` in pluginsintegration.go, and the helper `instrumentContext` now lives in the contextual logger middleware. This leaves the 'consistent naming' goal of the PR only partly done.
